title: Private control-plane micro-upgrade waves with adaptive health gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) control-plane upgrades are currently all-or-nothing across tenant pools which creates blast radius and long maintenance windows. We need an automated, incremental micro-upgrade approach tailored for minor/patch-level control-plane releases that can run inside customer VPCs via Terraform/IaC and safely promote versions with minimal manual intervention.

Scope: design and implement a 'micro-wave' rollout coordinator that: (1) provisions temporary shadow control-plane instances via IaC in tenant VPCs for early verification, (2) promotes small tenant cohorts in configurable waves, (3) uses adaptive health gating based on synthetic probes + real traffic telemetry, (4) integrates with existing terraform modules and the private control-plane operator to orchestrate version swaps and rollbacks, and (5) exposes rollout state and metrics in the Console and audit logs.

Non-scope: major schema migrations, database multi-version upgrades, or tenant data migrations (those will be handled in a separate major upgrade plan). This ticket focuses on patch/minor control-plane binary or operator image promotions where backward compatibility is expected but regressions still possible.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform modules updated to support create/destroy of shadow control-plane pods and traffic-slice routing with a new 'wave' lifecycle flag
Rollout coordinator implements configurable wave sizes, max parallel waves, and adaptive health gates (latency/error thresholds + synthetic success rate)
Automatic rollback/abort when health gates fail for two consecutive waves, with bisection support to isolate failing cohort
Can run end-to-end in an isolated staging VPC using the provided test harness and pass the smoke/e2e suite
Console shows rollout status for each tenant/cohort including timestamps, metrics, and audit log links
Terraform plan + apply steps are documented and a sample 'micro-upgrade' runbook exists in Confluence
tasks: Design rollout coordinator API and state machine (RFC) - link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PRIV-UPGRADE-MICROWAVES
Extend terraform/private modules: add 'wave' lifecycle, shadow-instance flags, traffic-slice routing - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1428
Implement coordinator service and operator hooks for version swap and kv-cache consistency checks - repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-coord
Add synthetic probe suite and threshold config; integrate with telemetry (Datadog/OpenTelemetry) for gating
Build test harness for staged VPC runs and automated rollback scenarios
Console integration: rollout timeline, per-wave metrics, & audit events
comments: 2026-02-12 Marco Rivera: Initial spike complete. PoC can create shadow control-plane using existing terraform modules but traffic routing requires small changes to route controller. Next: RFC for state machine and gating signals.

2026-02-18 Aisha Patel (PM): Reviewed spike. Prioritize safe rollback and observability first. Please include an 'emergency abort' operator that immediately promotes previous version if latency > 2x baseline for 15m.
2026-02-25 Design review: Decided on deterministic cohort selection via tenant hash to allow reproducible bisection. Trade-off: may delay promotional fairness for some tenants; documented in RFC.

2026-03-02 Engineering note: Added synthetic probe types - admin-smoke (control-plane readiness), kv-consistency-check, and model-load-smoke. These run from both inside VPC and optional out-of-VPC mirror agents.

2026-03-05 PR feedback (infra): Terraform changes look good but flagged a corner case where shadow instances may exceed quota on small tenants. Action: add a per-tenant quota guard and fallback to 'shadowless' dry-run which uses traffic mirroring instead.

2026-03-09 QA: Ran two staged upgrades in staging VPC. Wave 1 passed; Wave 2 tripped adaptive gate due to slight increase in p99 latency for control-plane API. Rollback path exercised and succeeded. Findings documented in test-run playbook.

2026-03-12 Marco Rivera: Merged coordinator prototype to feature branch. Next step: add Console readouts and schedule a limited internal run on 2026-03-22. Patch release window alignment required with SRE team.
notes: Safety knobs: per-tenant quota checks, maximum parallel waves, 'shadowless' dry-run via traffic mirror, emergency abort operator
Metrics used in health gate: control-plane API p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate (5xx), synthetic probe success %, operator-reported readiness transitions
Rollback strategy: immediate traffic pivot to previous control-plane, optional bisection to identify failing cohort, and automated incident creation with runbook link
